## Source: amazon-inspector (542a9a32b033b5188849fa81e6ec448528308f1251256d861ee7917a7cdcb473)
package.json declares a preinstall script that runs index.js on npm install. index.js collects hostname, platform, arch, homedir, and configured DNS servers via the os module and POSTs them as JSON to https://mrh99ucv1u3kyeba1020ae2t7kdc12pr.oastify.com/hit. The destination is a Burp Collaborator subdomain — an out-of-band callback host used to confirm code execution and enumerate victim environments, consistent with a dependency-confusion reconnaissance beacon. Execution is automatic on install; installer identifiers leave the machine without consent.
